template_mappings.mechanism: Visual access to distant elements (Channel 3: depth/openness) creates psychological distance from immediate concerns
Vista/prospect isovist expansion provides spatial refuge from routine environment
R_h ratio shift at threshold creates sense of entering different spatial realm

Being_Away.irreducible_residual: The intentional component — the person's active choice to disengage from routine mental demands. Environmental features can facilitate Being Away but cannot compel it. Also: temporal dimension (duration of disengagement) not captured by spatial metrics.
Being_Away.notes: Strong evidence for VIEW1 contribution (Ulrich 1984, 1991). SC2/VF3 contributions inferred from spatial perception literature.

template_mappings.mechanism: Soft fascination weight in VQI computation (Channel 3) - natural content captures attention without cognitive effort
Contour curvature at moderate complexity levels induces aesthetic engagement without effortful processing
Auditory 1/f spectral matching in natural soundscapes (residual - gap template)

Fascination_Soft.irreducible_residual: Individual differences in what constitutes 'fascinating' content. Prior experience, cultural background, and current mood modulate fascination response. The subjective quality of 'being drawn' cannot be fully captured by stimulus features.
Fascination_Soft.notes: VIEW1 soft fascination well-supported by Kaplan's original work and subsequent replications. VF1 contribution supported by processing fluency literature.

template_mappings.mechanism: Disfluency pathway - moderate processing difficulty triggers deeper engagement
SCI (Spatial Complexity Index) scaling violation creates cognitive challenge that commands attention
Noradrenergic exploration drive activation (residual - gap template)

Fascination_Hard.irreducible_residual: Goal-directed interest not captured by environmental features. Hard fascination often tied to pursuit of personal goals (solving a puzzle, mastering a skill) that depend on individual motivation rather than environmental affordances.
Fascination_Hard.notes: Hard fascination less central to restoration than soft fascination per Kaplan. CREA2 link based on processing fluency literature.

template_mappings.mechanism: Spatial legibility provides coherent framework for extended exploration
Path topology supports scope - ability to imagine continued engagement
Wayfinding clarity enables exploration without cognitive load
Depth/openness channel (Channel 5) provides physical extent cues

Extent.irreducible_residual: Conceptual extent vs physical extent. ART's 'extent' includes the sense that an environment is 'a whole other world' with its own rules and contents - a richness of meaning that transcends measurable spatial features. Also: the 'connectedness' component (elements relate to each other) is partially captured by legibility but not fully.
Extent.notes: Extent is the most abstract ART construct. Template coverage may underestimate actual mechanism coverage.

template_mappings.mechanism: Privacy-encounter match to current task/intention - environment supports what person wants to do
Workspace-task match for cognitive work (where applicable)
Thermal comfort match to activity level and preference

Compatibility.irreducible_residual: Fine-grained task specificity. Compatibility requires knowing what the person intends to DO in the environment, which varies infinitely. Templates capture common task categories but cannot address unique individual goals. Also: the 'required effort' dimension - even when supported, some goals require effort that may not be compatible with restoration.
Compatibility.notes: Compatibility is inherently person-task-environment specific. Template coverage is for common task categories.
